Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When traditional payment gateways like Stripe and PayPal are restricted or unavailable, entrepreneurs and digital creators are left with limited options for accepting online payments. This is where Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments come in - a free and open source infrastructure that allows you to build a digital store that accepts crypto payments without relying on traditional payment gateways. By using Cloudflare Pages as the hosting platform, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing, you can create a digital store that's not only free to deploy, but also secure, scalable, and sovereign.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to have a few things in place. First, you'll need to sign up for a Cloudflare account and create a new project. Next, you'll need to create a new GitHub Pages site and connect it to your Cloudflare project. Finally, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account and configure it to work with your Cloudflare Pages site. If you're not familiar with these tools, don't worry - this guide will walk you through the process step by step.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your Cloudflare Pages site set up, it's time to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves setting up a NOWPayments account, configuring it to work with your Cloudflare Pages site, and setting up a delivery pipeline for your digital products. By setting up a delivery pipeline, you can ensure that your customers receive their digital products automatically, without having to rely on manual processing.
